```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
```

@fig-scatter displays the daily ozone concentration (ppb) vs. temperature (F) in NY over five months in the interactive plot.
```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Interactive daily ozone concentration vs. temperature in New York."

p <- ggplot(airquality, aes(x = Temp, y = Ozone, color = factor(Month))) +
 geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
 labs(
   x = "Temperature (°F)",
   y = "Ozone (ppb)",
   color = "Month"
   ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)
```
@tbl-airquality shows a statistical summary of data presented in @fig-scatter
```{r}
#| label: tbl-airquality
#| tbl-cap: "Statistical Summary"
psych:: describe(airquality) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

Our sample size is '{r} nrow(airquality)'.
@fig-cbl shows location of UMCES CBL lab in an interactice map
```{r}
#| label: fig-cbl
#| fig-cap: "Location of UMCES Chesapeake Biological Laboratory."

leaflet() %>%
   addTiles() %>%  # Default OpenStreetMap base tiles
   addMarkers(
       lng = -76.4533, 
       lat = 38.3191, 
       popup = "UMCES - Chesapeake Biological Laboratory"
 ) |>
    setView(-76.4533, 38.3191, zoom =7)
```
